vendors.name: Aembit Workload IAM
vendors.offering: Workload IAM: secretless, policy-based access using native cloud identities across clouds
vendors.pricing: free Starter up to 10 workloads; paid tiers not confirmed publicly; AWS Marketplace contracts

vendors.name: Teleport Machine & Workload Identity
vendors.offering: Short-lived certificates and workload identity for machines, CI/CD and services
vendors.pricing: not public (bundled in Enterprise Standard; extra MWIs priced per unit)

vendors.name: Defakto (formerly SPIRL)
vendors.offering: SPIFFE-based non-human identity platform issuing short-lived workload identities

vendors.name: HCP Vault Dedicated (HashiCorp/IBM)
vendors.offering: Secrets manager with dynamic short-lived AWS credentials via AWS secrets engine
vendors.pricing: hourly cluster fee (~$1.58/h Essentials small) plus ~$72.92/client/month

vendors.name: Akeyless
vendors.offering: SaaS secrets and machine identity with workload identity federation across clouds
vendors.pricing: free 5 clients; paid tiers not public

vendors.name: Infisical
vendors.offering: Open-core secrets and machine identity with AWS IAM role-based auth

vendors.name: Oasis NHI Security Cloud
vendors.offering: Non-human identity discovery, posture and lifecycle management

vendors.name: CyberArk (Palo Alto Networks)
vendors.offering: Machine identity, secrets management and PAM, now part of Palo Alto platform

paid_market_gaps.gap: Per-identity/per-client pricing scales with machine count, punishing workload-heavy teams (Infisical $18/identity, Vault ~$73/client).
Paid secrets tools lag new AWS mechanisms: Vault lacked IAM Roles Anywhere; External Secrets broke on EKS Pod Identity.
Workload identity is sold as quote-only enterprise bundles (Teleport, Defakto, Oasis $50k starter); little self-serve mid-tier.
Consolidation (CyberArk to Palo Alto, Astrix to Cisco) leaves buyers wary of standalone NHI vendor roadmaps.

wtp_evidence: Established paid products with public prices: HCP Vault ~$72.92/client/month, Infisical Pro $18/identity/month, Oasis $50k/year starter; NHI vendors raise large rounds (Defakto $30.75M).
bundling_note: AWS gives IRSA, EKS Pod Identity and IAM Roles Anywhere (no service charge) plus SDK default-chain support for free, covering the core in-AWS and off-AWS need.
summary: AWS-only role credentials are free and native; paid money sits in multi-cloud workload identity/NHI platforms, already crowded and consolidating. A narrow opening: cheap self-serve cross-cloud workload identity for mid-market teams priced against per-identity Vault/Infisical bills.
